content.text: ▪︎2-7% prevalence, may be lower in Asian population
: ⇡ age, family HX, iron deficiency, ADs, APs, DA antagonists, antiemetics, antihistamines, comorbidities (e.g., CV disease)
urge to move legs in response to uncomfortable sensation
disorders (Parkinson’s, multiple system atrophy, Lewy body disease)
▪︎HX suggestive of REM sleep behavior d/o + established synucleinopathy (e.g., Parkinson’s)
that are brief and usually occur during the first one-third of the sleep episode
: sleep deprivation, irregular sleep schedule, stress, fatigue, OSA, nocturnal seizures, fever, medications (sedative-hypnotics, lithium, anticholinergics),
➀ Recurrent episodes of incomplete awakening from sleep, usually occurring during first third of
the major sleep episode, accompanies by ONE of the following:
: rising from bed during sleep & walking about; blank, staring face, unresponsive
to communication from others, difficult to awake
(mydriasis, tachycardia, rapid breathing, sweating), unresponsive to comforting efforts
